title: ResponderOutput
description: The response object the responder writes into recovery.json. Inputs: the VERDICT line at the end of agent_response.md, the file diff recorded in write-scope.json, and the endpoint probes recorded alongside this object. The agent itself never produces JSON: it is launched with --tools read,grep,find,ls,edit (no bash), so the only thing it can emit is text, and the evidence it was given lives in evidence.md. Previously this schema claimed additionalProperties:false over fields nobody populated and no code ever validated.

summary.description: One line: affected endpoint plus the agent's stated cause.

root_cause.description: Text after the dash in the agent's VERDICT line. 'not stated by the agent' when the line was missing.

action.description: fix = VERDICT fixed and every write stayed under app/. false_positive = VERDICT no-action. escalate = VERDICT needs-human, no VERDICT at all, or any out-of-scope write.

status.description: resolved requires isRecovered(): the check ran, no probe answered 5xx, and no probe failed to answer. pending means the agent acted but health is unconfirmed -- the app is not hot-reloading. escalated covers needs-human, a missing VERDICT, and out-of-scope writes.

details.description: The VERDICT line, plus why status is not resolved (which probes were 5xx or returned nothing) whenever it is not.

fix_commit_message.description: Suggested message only. Nothing in this system can commit: the image has no git. A human applies it.
